question: What extraordinary powers over time and bodily form arise in this advanced state?
premises: Time can be eluded or overcome
These are presented as resulting powers
inference: This state brings the overcoming of time and the transformation of form.
uncertainties: vañcanaṃ may mean deception, evasion, or transcendence depending on context
plain_english: O Goddess, there is the overcoming of time and the transformation of form.
